abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 139 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 179 | 600 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.5 | 5.8 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.4 | 4.2 | 600 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
